files.description: Review rules R1-R17 and the list of checks tools already enforce. Cite rule numbers in findings.
Staged pipeline architecture: connections, routers, handlers, store and API.
HL7 conventions: tolerant parsing, payload-agnostic ingress, ACK/NAK timing, binary carriage.
PHI threat model, logging inventory and redaction rules, attached for de-identification code. The synthetic-test-data rule covers tests and samples.
What the operator API accepts for each kind of input: ids, names, time bounds, search terms.
Input surfaces outside the operator API, and the rules for what each input must look like.
Code quality rubric the project holds Python changes to.
